records.title: Brownfield Testability Gate — Track A (Full Green Baseline)

deliveredIncrements.notes: Decomposed into 5 sub-increments per specs/tasks/rw-001-subtasks.md, delivered in order rw-001a -> rw-001b -> rw-001d -> rw-001e -> rw-001c (Entra last because of the external blocker). All ACs #1-#10 closed at code level. ADR-008 captures the dual-mode rationale (config-gated OIDC; dev-stub remains the default when AzureAd:ClientId is empty). Test-harness insight recorded in rw-001c.impl.testHarnessInsight: WebApplicationFactory.WithWebHostBuilder.ConfigureAppConfiguration runs DURING builder.Build(), so config-gated registrations that read builder.Configuration before Build() must be tested by mutating Environment.SetEnvironmentVariable + restoring in try/finally + instantiating a fresh WebApplicationFactory<Program>.

currentIncrement.title: DepartmentsController
currentIncrement.scope: Port DepartmentsController CRUD + Razor views (Index, Details, Create, Edit, Delete) under [Authorize(Roles=Admin,Reader)] per ADR-006 (Reader for read-only Index/Details, Admin for Create/Edit/Delete). Use Department + Administrator (FK -> Instructor) entities; Web project SchoolContext already has DbSet<Department>. Concurrency token (RowVersion) handling preserved per legacy.
acceptanceCriteria: AC#1: Anonymous GET /Departments redirects to login (auth boundary preserved per rw-001)
AC#2: Reader-role GET /Departments returns 200 with department list (RowVersion column hidden in HTML)
AC#3: Reader-role POST /Departments/Create returns 403 Forbidden (read-only role)
AC#4: Admin-role full CRUD (Create, Edit, Delete) + concurrency-token round-trip works (concurrent edit detection)
AC#5: Department.Administrator dropdown populates from Instructors
AC#6: Regression — rw-001 + rw-002 stay green; CSP unchanged; SEC-CRITICAL-001 still closed for /Departments
currentIncrement.notes: rw-003 is the first authenticated CRUD increment in the rewrite chain. Dependency on rw-001 (auth pipeline) and rw-002 (Home/Layout for nav) both satisfied. Deployment for rw-003 — like rw-001 + rw-002 — is deferred until USER ACTION unblocks the first azd up. Test approach: Cucumber scenarios for AC#1-#5 (anon redirect + role-based 200/403 + concurrency token round-trip) tagged @rewrite @rw-003 @feature-F-004 @red-baseline; xUnit unit tests for any controller action that doesn't require HTTP semantics. The test harness from rw-001c (WebApplicationFactory + dev-stub auth + role claims) is reusable here for unit-level role testing.
